title: Codex Plugin Manifest Schema
description: Schema for the generated plugins/<name>/.codex-plugin/plugin.json — the Codex-target counterpart to plugins/<name>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json (R6).
$comment: Repository exposure schema, not an official OpenAI schema. Codex CLI 0.157.0 install/list and app-server skills/list verify the generated skill paths. commands must be [] to suppress compatibility migration of Claude commands. hooks/list verifies registration and untrusted state only; hook execution and authenticated MCP use require separate runtime checks. See docs/runtime-install-smoke.md and docs/research/codex-phase-1-2026-10-05/report.md.

name.description: Must match the plugin's directory name and its package.json 'name' (sole version/name authority, R3).

description.description: Target-specific description override from the catalog when present, else the shared description (R6).

commands.description: Repository exposure policy: require an explicit empty list to suppress Codex compatibility migration of Claude commands into extra skills. Verified with codex-cli 0.157.0; see https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/rust-v0.157.0/codex-rs/core-plugins/src/command_migration/plugin.rs. Omission enables commands/ discovery, bypassing the catalog skill allowlist.

skills.description: Manifest-relative path to the normalized Codex skill tree, e.g. './codex/skills' (R7). Directory-path pattern mirrored from schemas/plugin.schema.json's 'relativeDir' definition (no absolute prefixes, no '..' traversal).

hooks.description: Generated local hook config path. Pinned 0.157.0 lifecycle execution is separately tested with exact disposable trust.

mcpServers.description: Explicit file reference or target-selected public HTTPS URL-only map. No Claude userConfig, headers, credential environment or substitutions.

author.description: Shared catalog attribution. The legacy 0.157.0 parser ignores this top-level metadata; interface.developerName carries runtime presentation.
